title: Acura Integra Engines by Year (1986–2026)
description: Every factory engine in the Acura Integra by year: the D16 and B-series fours of 1986–2001, the GS-R and Type R VTEC engines, and the 2023-on turbos.
intro: The Integra was one of Acura's two launch models in 1986. It was replaced by the RSX for 2002 and the name returned for 2023.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.

generations.name: Second generation
intro: The 1.8 B18A1, with the 1.7 B17A1 VTEC in the 1992–1993 GS-R.

generations.name: Third generation
intro: The 1.8 B18B1, the B18C1 VTEC in the GS-R and the B18C5 in the Type R. There was no 1999 US Type R.

generations.name: Fifth generation
intro: The 1.5 turbo, and the 2.0 turbo in the Type S from 2024.
